dataset.name: GuitarSet
dataset.citation: Q. Xi, R. Bittner, J. Pauwels, X. Ye, and J. P. Bello, "GuitarSet: A Dataset for Guitar Transcription," ISMIR 2018.
dataset.license_source: Zenodo record 3371780 license field, read before download.
dataset.audio_representation: Official mono-microphone WAV named {id}_mic.wav inside audio_mono-mic.zip. No resampling and no downmix in this script.
errata_excluded: 04_BN3-154-E_comp timing offset reported in marl/GuitarSet issue 5
04_Jazz1-200-B_comp timing offset reported in marl/GuitarSet issue 5
02_Funk2-119-G_comp duplicated note reported in marl/GuitarSet issue 4
dataset.annotation_limitations: Zenodo states that the hexaphonic pickup largely automates annotation. The version 0.9 chord layer is labeled semi-automatic with manual verification, and its segmentation and root come from sheet music. The other chord layer is the lead-sheet symbol on those same boundaries. Neither layer is treated as infallible. The tempo annotation is one constant value per excerpt.

normalization.primary_chord_reference: lead_sheet chord layer in the official JAMS (the layer that is not version 0.9)
normalization.exact: Unicode-stripped raw Harte string equality. No enharmonic rewrite, no bass deletion, no extension folding.
normalization.root: Pitch-class equality of the Harte root. Enharmonic spellings match. N matches neither a chord root nor a different no-chord label.
normalization.major_minor: Shorthand exactly maj/major or min/minor. Sevenths, half-diminished chords, suspensions, and parenthetical alterations stay outside this score. The denominator is lead-sheet time whose shorthand is a major or minor triad.
normalization.boundary: A reference segment is paired only when a prediction shares its root pitch class and overlaps at least half of the reference segment.
normalization.beats: One-to-one greedy match inside 70 ms. Inter-beat gaps in this sample are wider than 140 ms, so the windows do not overlap. This is not the mir_eval package.
normalization.submission_vocabulary: Qualities listed in submission_chord_list.txt, transposed from C. Coverage is reported and is not used to drop mismatches from the exact score.
normalization.aggregates: Macro is the unweighted mean of per-recording scores. Duration-weighted chord scores sum time. Micro beat scores pool counts.
normalization.enharmonic_shorthand: Secondary score. Root pitch class, shorthand, and bass agree. Flat and sharp spellings match. Extensions are not folded into triads. The primary exact score remains raw string equality.

selection_rule: Player index 00, comp version, progression 2, lower filename BPM of that progression. One excerpt from each style code BN, Funk, Jazz, Rock, and SS. Pinned before inference.

annotation.performed_source: Semi-automatic chord transcription with manual verification
annotation.performed_rules: Chord sheet-informed symbolic chord transcription based on the included separate string note transcriptions with the chord segmentation and root derived from sheet music.

beat_phase.note: Diagnostic only. The reported F-measure stays on the 70 ms window and is not retuned to this offset.
